content: {"praised":["Dan Aykroyd delivers strong comedic performance.","Film is a classic 80s comedy with memorable humor.","Characters like Dr. Detroit and Mom provide entertaining scenes.","Fran Drescher and supporting cast add comedic value.","Movie offers laugh-out-loud moments despite disjointed plot."],"criticized":["Plot is vague and disjointed.","Excessive profanity feels forced.","Stereotypes used for humor are offensive.","Visuals include walking mannequins with heavy makeup.","Anti-nerd portrayal is problematic."]}
